description:
Survey harness crates under `dev/active/` depend on `dev/tools/tuning-campaign-support` through relative paths that count directory levels, so any move breaks their build. This work chooses one depth-independent dependency form and applies it to the first ten crates.

## Background

Crates (under `dev/active/`): `04b85d10/survey/gf2-side`, `07ca8585/survey/arms`, `12fdeb5b/survey/nr-encode`, `1c602857/arms`, `1d0da41f/survey/ymm-clmul-arm`, `1d4fd63d/arms`, `1d4fd63d/external-arms`, `2037941f-profile-and-optimize-mid-range-buffer-operations/survey/dense-harness`, `2037941f-profile-and-optimize-mid-range-buffer-operations/survey/harness`, `3be770d5/survey/harness`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the ten crates listed below declares every path dependency in one depth-independent form, chosen and justified in a linked record against the alternatives (for example a repository-root Cargo configuration or a fixed-location harness workspace). Relative paths that count directory levels are not used.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each changed crate builds from its current location and from a copy one directory level deeper.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each harness `Cargo.toml` changes only in its path-dependency declarations, once; the commit records each edit. The shared form may add a `[patch]` table to the repository `.cargo/config.toml` and change the affected `Cargo.lock` files.
- [hard] REQ-04: Before the change, the benchmark-acceptance verdicts for every committed `zen3-benchmark-receipt-v1` receipt are recorded, and after the change they are identical, so committed receipts keep verifying through their byte-identical snapshot copies.
- [hard] REQ-05: No historical-path allow-list or hard-coded `dev/` path remains in the changed consumer; code review checks the change against `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`.

## Notes

A digest-pinned harness manifest may change once, to the depth-independent form.

## Decisions

- DEC-01: The owner decided on 2026-10-03 that the scope covers every path dependency of the harness crates and that the depth-independent form may use a `[patch]` table in the repository `.cargo/config.toml`, with the resulting `Cargo.lock` changes.
title: Make the first survey-harness crates' tool dependency depth-independent
